items.before: Before, viewing a submitted notification showed 'Review your notification' under the status strip. Now the heading is the notification reference with a 'Submitted' tag beside it and 'Date submitted' underneath, with no status strip, and the browser tab title starts with the reference. Back goes to the set's own notification list, and asking for a notification that does not exist goes there too. Plants' read-only view takes the same header in place of 'Check your answers'.
items.after:
Before, viewing a submitted notification showed 'Review your notification' under the status strip.

Now the page is headed by:

- the notification reference, with a 'Submitted' tag beside it
- 'Date submitted' underneath

There is no status strip.

The browser tab title starts with the reference.

Back goes to the set's own notification list.

Asking for a notification that does not exist goes there too.

Plants' read-only view takes the same header in place of 'Check your answers'.

items.before: Submitting records its date and outstanding items, and a notification still missing its health certificate shows as 'Submitted action required'
items.after: Submitting a notification records its date and its outstanding items. A notification still missing its health certificate shows as 'Submitted action required'.

items.before: The view now offers 'Amend this notification' as the main button, with 'Copy as new' beside it and a red 'Delete'. Each still goes through the service's own amend, copy and delete steps, with no pop-ups. Plants' view offers Amend and a red 'Delete notification', moved up from the foot of the page, and no Copy as new.
items.after:
The view now offers:

- 'Amend this notification', as the main button
- 'Copy as new', beside it
- a red 'Delete'

Each still goes through the service's own amend, copy and delete steps.

There are no pop-ups.

Plants' view offers:

- Amend
- a red 'Delete notification', moved up from the foot of the page

Plants' view has no Copy as new.

items.before: A new 'Import reference numbers' section warns 'You must use the correct reference and code on the customs declaration or your consignment will be delayed.' and shows the notification reference and the customs document code 'C640' as plain text the trader can select. It also shows on a draft's review. The prototype's Copy buttons wait on design. Plants shows the notification reference only, until plants' own customs document code is confirmed.
items.after:
There is a new 'Import reference numbers' section.

It warns: 'You must use the correct reference and code on the customs declaration or your consignment will be delayed.'

It shows these as plain text the trader can select:

- the notification reference
- the customs document code 'C640'

The section also shows on a draft's review.

The prototype's Copy buttons wait on design.

Plants shows the notification reference only, until plants' own customs document code is confirmed.

items.before: Before, a notification submitted without its health certificate looked like any other submitted one. Now its view shows an orange 'Submitted action required' tag, the warning 'You need to upload a health certificate', and 'Upload a valid health certificate' in the uploaded documents section. Continue at the foot starts an amendment and opens the overview, so the trader can upload it. The INS home's notification table links these notifications to their view, as it does submitted ones. This is live animals only, because it rests on the ITAHC.
items.after:
Before, a notification submitted without its health certificate looked like any other submitted one.

Now its view shows:

- an orange 'Submitted action required' tag
- the warning 'You need to upload a health certificate'
- 'Upload a valid health certificate' in the uploaded documents section

Continue at the foot of the page starts an amendment and opens the overview.

This lets the trader upload the health certificate.

The INS home's notification table links these notifications to their view, as it does for submitted ones.

This is live animals only, because it rests on the ITAHC.

items.before: Submitting records its date and outstanding items, and a notification still missing its health certificate shows as 'Submitted action required'
items.after: Submitting a notification records its date and its outstanding items. A notification still missing its health certificate shows as 'Submitted action required'.
